reviews.title: Great app, shame they made it so expensive
reviews.text: I had this app for years and it was absolutely worth $20/year. $99/year (and not even a lifetime subscription option) is wild. Totally missed the mark with pricing.

reviews.title: Inusabile
reviews.text:
App bella ma inutile. si può creare solo una abitudine (non 2 o 3, ma solo 1) e poi serve l’abbonamento che costa 59 euro anno.
Qual è il senso di fare un app che gratuitamente non si può far nulla? Chi spende 60€ all’anno senza poterla usare realmente?

That tied to the fact they track location when you let them means an unsafe app in these dark times of ICE and DHS becoming perverted and demented.
